form_analysis.feedback: Strong aftercare form for a treatment targeting pigmentation. Excellently emphasizes the critical importance of sun protection as part of the treatment outcome, not just aftercare. Clear guidance on managing potential mild peeling and avoiding pigment-triggering factors.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is crucial to protect your skin, prevent post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, and ensure you achieve the optimal brightening and even-toned results from your treatment.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow this aftercare advice meticulously. Sun protection is a non-negotiable part of your treatment protocol.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: Your skin may be pink, feel slightly tight, warm, or tingly for 12-48 hours. Mild flaking or peeling in areas where pigment is concentrated may occur 2-4 days post-treatment. This is a normal part of the cell renewal process.

sections.title: Sun Protection - THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP
items: You MUST avoid direct sun exposure completely for at least 48 hours.
You MUST apply a broad-spectrum UVA/UVB sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher (SPF 50+ is ideal) every single day, regardless of weather or indoor status, for the next 2 weeks and indefinitely thereafter.
Reapply sunscreen every 2 hours if you are outdoors. Wear a wide-brimmed hat for added protection.

sections.title: Cleansing and Product Use
items: Cleanse gently with a lukewarm water and a mild, non-exfoliating cleanser for the first 3 days.
Do not use any other active brightening products (e.g., Vitamin C, hydroquinone, prescription retinoids) for 5-7 days unless specifically instructed by your therapist.
Absolutely avoid any physical exfoliation (scrubs, brushes) or chemical exfoliation (AHA/BHA) for 7 days.
Use a gentle, reparative moisturizer to soothe the skin.

sections.title: Managing Peeling and Dryness
sections.content: Do not pick, peel, or scratch any flaking skin. Allow it to shed naturally. Picking can cause scarring and reverse brightening effects by triggering more pigment. Keep the skin well-moisturized to ease any tightness.

sections.title: Activity and Environmental Restrictions
items: Avoid heat-based activities (strenuous exercise, saunas, hot yoga, steam rooms) for 48 hours to minimise inflammation and flushing.
Avoid swimming in chlorinated or salt water for 48 hours.

sections.title: Dietary and Lifestyle Considerations
sections.content: Avoid alcohol and spicy foods for 24 hours as they can cause flushing. Continue to avoid sun exposure as per above instructions.

sections.title: Infection Awareness
sections.content: Contact your therapist if you experience signs of infection such as increasing pain, yellow crusting, or pus. Severe itching or a blistering rash may indicate a reaction and should also be reported.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: Your skin may appear slightly darker before it exfoliates and reveals brighter skin. Final, visible lightening results are typically seen 7-14 days post-treatment as the new skin surface emerges.
Multiple treatments are almost always necessary for significant brightening. Consistency with home care (especially SPF) is paramount for success.
Contact your therapist if you have any concerns during the healing process.
